Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh will know that they have been very poor in this Test with both bat and ball. They didn't apply themselves well enough and hence are in this position, trying to save the game following-on on the second day itself. They will bat for a short time today, hoping to not lose any wicket. Let's see how they go. The hosts are going to hunt them down, it seems.

South Africa have enforced the follow-on! Superb bowling performance by them. They have dismissed the visitors inside 50 overs for a paltry total of 147, thereby gaining a 426-run lead. It was Kagiso Rabada who led the way with 5/33. He was well backed by Duanne Olivier and Wayne Parnell. Liton Das was the only one fighting for the away side with a 70.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Fast, fiery and accurate. 6th five-wicket haul for the youngster. He is a special talent and he has again proved why. Stepped up and rose to the occasion in the absence of their premier pace bowlers. Rabada bowls a pinpoint yorker in line of the stumps, Hossain backs away as he has done throughout his innings and looks to keep it out. However, it is too good for him and the ball crashes into the stumps. That's the final nail in the coffin. BANGLADESH ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 147!
Full length delivery on leg stump, Rubel backs away and mistimes his slog to mid on.
Back of a length following the batsman, Hossain backs away and dabs it to gully.
Rubel Hossain has taken a blow on his right arm and is in a lot of pain. It is quite swollen. The magic spray comes out. Bangladesh will hope that the pacer is alright.

Ouch! That's nasty! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Hossain looks to keep it out but takes a blow on his forearm. He walks away in discomfort and his ringing his hand. Always dangerous the way he plays, he has been hit finally.
In the zone outside off, left alone.
Tossed up this time, blocked watchfully.
Flighted on off, Roy comes forward and pushes it uppishly towards Elgar at silly point. He reacts a bit early and the ball goes past him.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, spinning away. Subashis lets it go.
Flighted delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Floated outside off, Roy prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge towards du Plessis at second slip.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
In the air... but safe! Hossain makes room to the length delivery and mistimes it towards Parnell at short extra cover. He leaps but the ball just goes over him. Two runs taken.
Another bumper, Rubel sits underneath it.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Rubel attempts an agricultural slog but mistimes it to mid on.
Hossain backs away to a good length delivery and swings his arms but gets beaten. That one swung late.
Dug in short on leg stump, Hossain ducks under it.
Coming in with the arm, Roy looks to keep it out but gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg. Two runs taken.
Outside off, left alone.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly.
Subashis Roy is the last man in.

OUT! Gone! Another one bites the dust. Slow through the air outside off, spinning in. Rahman prods forward to smother the turn but seems to have got a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs towards Aiden Markram at short leg who takes it and appeals confidently. However, the umpire stays put. Faf is confident as well and goes for the review straightaway. The replays roll in. It confirms a thick inside edge. The third umpire takes a long time to rule it out for some reason. Successful review for South Africa. Bangladesh are falling down like a pack of cards. They still need 231 runs more to avoid the follow-on.
South Africa are confident that Rahman has edge one onto his pads as he is caught at short leg. Review taken. Looks close, let's see.
Strides forward and defends it with the spin to short leg.
Stays back to the shorter delivery and blocks it.
Mustafizur Rahman comes out to bat.

OUT! Rabada is so effective in breaking partnerships, rises to the occasion again! Liton Das departs after playing a brilliant knock. Back of a length ball on off, skids through the surface. Das goes for the pull but is hurried into it by the pace on that delivery. Ends up getting a top edge that spoons over the slip cordon. Faf du Plessis from second slip backtracks and so does Bavuma from gully. The skipper calls for the catch and takes it nicely reverse cup. End of a fighting knock by the Bangladesh keeper.
On a length outside off, pushed firmly off the front foot to covers.
Angling into Das, clipped to mid-wicket.
Similar length delivery, angling in. Liton comes forward and blocks it.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven crisply to covers.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, played with soft hands towards short mid-wicket.
Rabada comes back for a bowl.
Floated delivery, Hossain prods forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Hossain pushes another one to the same region.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid on.

Not out! Shorter in length, coming in with the arm. Hossain looks to keep it out but gets an inside edge. The ball lobs off something towards silly point. Dean Elgar stationed there dives to his left to grab it and claims the catch. The umpires come across and have a conversation. It is referred upstairs. The soft signal is out. Time for the replays. It shows that the inside edge deflected off the boot. Now, is the catch clean? No, it is not as Elgar didn't quite have his fingers underneath the ball as he tried to pick it up. A brilliant effort nonetheless.
A appeal for a catch at silly point is referred upstairs. The soft signal is out.
Tossed up delivery, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Fourth boundary of the over. Loosener down the leg side, Das tickles it through the vacant short fine leg region to find the fence. 16 from that over. Hashim Amla, Dean Elgar and Faf du Plessis are not happy one bit.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! The more he is batting, the better he is looking. Full length ball on middle and leg, Das clips it past the diving mid on fielder in flamingo style for a majestic boundary. There was some swagger in that shot.

FOUR! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Das leans ahead and drives it sweetly towards mid off. Parnell dives full length to his right but the ball goes past him in a flash and through to the fence. Wayne is disappointed with himself.
Strides forward to a fuller length ball outside off and strokes it to short cover.
FOUR! Brilliant! Short delivery on off, Das stands tall and pulls it hard through mid-wicket. Great control in that shot and the ball races to the fence.
Fullish delivery on off, Das checks his drive towards mid on.
Slow through the air on middle, Hossain defends it tentatively.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stays back to the shorter delivery and blocks it.
Coming in with the arm, Rubel prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up around leg stump, Hossain heaves it against the spin through wide mid on to pick up another boundary.
Floated around off, defended off the front foot to silly point.
Time for spin again. Keshav Maharaj comes back for a bowl. A slip, silly point and short leg in place.
Swinging in from around off, Das strides forward and with a high elbow defends it stoutly. He has looked so comfortable till now.
Fractionally overpitched on off, patted back to the bowler.
On a length on leg stump, stays a bit low. Liton clips it to long leg for another brace.
Short delivery on middle, sits up nicely for Das. He pulls it with good timing through mid-wicket. Olivier near the ropes sprints to his left and keeps it down to a couple.
Walks ahead to a length delivery outside off and strokes it sweetly to covers.
Jagging back sharply from a length outside off, Das knows where his off stump is and makes a good leave.
Das has a huge smile on his face after that boundary for Rubel. South Africa have not quite bowled well after the first six wickets. Time to get back Rabada back?
FOUR! Shot! That will give the tailender some confidence. Olivier comes around the wicket and serves a half-volley on middle and leg. Hossain drives it confidently past mid on to find the fence.
Fullish delivery, swinging into Rubel. He drives it off the toe end of the bat to covers.
Hossain makes room again and Olivier bangs it short on off. Hossain sways away from the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length on off, swinging in. Rubel keeps it out on the leg side.
Length delivery around off, Hossain makes room to play it square of the wicket on the off side but gets beaten.
Olivier bangs this one short in line of the stumps, Hossain backs away to play an ambitious pull but it is too high.
Leg slip in place. The floodlights have been turned on at the stadium, the shadows of the stands are now really long and covering almost the entire ground.
Similar length delivery outside off, Liton lets it go.
Length delivery outside off, Liton pushes it crisply to covers where Rabada dives to his right to make a good stop. Denies the batsmen a run.
Das again takes a confident stride forward and strokes this one to mid off.
Fullish delivery around off, eased off the front foot to short extra cover.
On a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Full length delivery in line of the stumps, eased to mid on.
Full length delivery on middle and leg, Hossain prods forward to defend but gets it off the inner half beside the pitch on the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, holding its line. Rubel doesn't fiddle with it.

Close shave! That was a weird way to deal with it. Slower delivery on a length on leg stump. Hossain backs away and looks to block it but misses. The ball brushes his pad and just goes past the leg stump.
In the zone outside off, left alone.
Rubel Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! The change of angle brings about the downfall of Islam! The spinner's resistance comes to an end and also the 50-run stand. Olivier steams in from around the wicket and bowls a good length delivery outside off, gets it to angle in prodigiously. Taijul stays back and looks to keep it out but leaves a big gap between his bat and pad. The ball goes right through there and disturbs the furniture behind. Duanne has his third.
Length delivery on off, defended solildly off the back foot.
Time for Drinks.
Straying on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a run.

2nd Test fifty for Liton Das! Back of a length outside off, Das taps it to cover-point for a run. Islam comes across to congratulate him. The entire Bangladesh dressing room is up on its feet. It has been an innings of substance. The top order needs to learn from him.
Das look to clip this through mid-wicket, looking for a run but gets a soft leading edge down the track.
FOUR! Shot! Shortish delivery around off, Das gets into position quickly and pulls it with authority past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary. He is looking rock solid.
Full length delivery outside off, a bit of nibble in the air. Liton eases it to covers.
Fuller length delivery outside off, holding its line. Das plants his front foot across to let it go.
Almost! Good length outside off, Taijul aims to cut it but ends up chopping it behind the wickets off the bottom edge.
A tad short around off, Taijul gets in line and defends it.
Slants it outside off on a fuller length, Islam throws his bat at it but cannot connect.
Full and angling on the stumps, turned through square leg for a single.
Length ball around middle, Islam punches it through backward point. Three runs taken as the point fielder does well to chase the ball and keep it in play.
Full and outside off, swinging further away, Islam looks to play at it from his crease but is beaten.
Hurls it outside off, gets it to zip off the surface, Das is beaten as he comes forward to defend that one. Good over by Andile.
Angles a length ball around off, pushed to covers by the batsman.
Good length outside off, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full and outside off, Das covers the line of the ball and blocks it.
Full and outside off, swinging away, left alone again by Liton.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Das.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes on for a bowl.
Shorter in length, going across the batsman, Islam looks to dab it through but fails to connect.
Shorter in length around off, Taijul rides the bounce and keeps it down.
A tad short around off, Islam drops his bat and lets it go at the end.
Good length outside off, tapped towards covers for a single.
Good length around middle and leg, Taijul tucks it to long leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, punched to deep point for a single. Ideal for SA, they would want to bowl more to Taijul.
Hurls it around off, on a length, Islam drops his bat and lets it go watchfully.
Angles it wide of the batsman, Islam is not bothered.
EDGED! Good length ball going across the batsman, Islam flays it wide of point for a couple of runs. 100 up for Bangladesh.
Good length outside off, punched to covers for a single. Slight fumble by Phehlukwayo but no harm done.
Full and wide outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Back of a length around off, Das defends it from his crease.
JUST WIDE! Shorter in length around middle and leg, Taijul fends at it. The ball flies wide of Markram at short leg. He has been very good in that area Aiden.
Shorter in length around middle, Taijul defends it from his crease.
Slants one around off, Taijul looks to play at it but cannot put bat to ball.

Bowls it on a good length but down the leg side, Islam looks to tuck it through but seems to have missed it. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Faf has a word with de Kock who is not confident enough. No review taken.
Good length around leg, Taijul tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Bowls it down the leg side on a length, Islam cannot clip it through.
Expected change. Duanne Olivier is back on.
FOUR! Pristine! Full and outside off, Das comes forward and drives it through the covers for a boundary. He is really looking good out there.
Fuller outside off, Das looks to defend but gets it off the bottom edge towards the slip cordon.
Full and outside off, left alone by Das.

Good length outside off, Islam slaps it through backward point for a couple of runs. Good running, gets them the third. He is starting to feel more comfortable. Maybe Faf needs to make a bowling change.
Full and outside off, pushed towards covers.
Edged! Fuller in length around off, Taijul comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully.
Fuller on middle and leg, Das aims to clip it through but finds Markram at short leg.
FOUR! And again! Length ball outside off, Das presses forward and punches it through covers. Maharaj tries to stop it from going through but cannot do so.
Shorter in length around off, Das defends it from his crease.
FOUR! Sublime! Rabada bowls it outside off on a driving length, Das gets right forward and creams it through covers for a majestic boundary. He has looked at ease.
Fuller in length on middle, Islam neatly turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter in length around off, nudged towards backward square leg for a single. A single early in the over? Strange.

NOT OUT! Waste of a review by SA! Parnell slants it on the pads, Islam can't clip and hence nudges it towards fine leg off the pads for a couple of leg byes. Hang on, Faf wants a review. Replays show that the ball was clearly going down leg. Not sure why South Africa took the review. Since the ball was are missing the wickets as per Ball Tracker, they have lost a review despite the impact being umpire's call.
South Africa decide to take a review against an LBW decision. Taijul Islam is the man in question. Seems to be clearly going down the leg side.
Good length around off and middle, Islam looks to defend but gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire signals an inside edge. Replays show that it was very high.
Good length wide outside off, left alone by Taijul.
Good length around off, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Just wide! Full and wide outside off, Das comes forward to drive but gets an outside edge which flies past the gully fielder for a boundary.
Good length around off, tucked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shorter in length from round the wicket, Taijul sits in his crease to let it go through.
Good length outside off, Liton taps it towards covers and takes a quick single. Good ploy with just a ball left.
Shorter in length around middle, Das is beaten on the pull this time around. The umpire signals it one for the over.
Good length outside off, no shot offered by Das.
FOUR! Top shot! Short by Rabada, Das is upto it and pulls it with disdain through backward square leg for a boundary.
Angles a full length ball around off, Das clips it nicely towards mid on from his crease.
Full and wide outside off, left alone by Islam. He has a wry smile on his face.
Shorter in length outside off, bounces more, Taijul looks to flay it away but fails to connect bat to ball.
Good length around middle, Islam defends it with a hop.
Shorter in length outside off, dabbed towards the slip cordon by Taijul.
Impressive Rabada! He has now become the leading wicket-taker in Tests in 2017.
Shortish and wide outside off, Taijul wants to slap it through covers but cannot connect.
Good length around off, Islam defends it towards covers.
Not this time, connects with his clip and takes a single to retain the strike. Not sure if that was ideal.
Goes very full on middle and leg, Islam just about fails to clip it through.

BANG! Welcome to the crease! Rabada angles a shorter length ball around middle, Islam gets into a tangle wanting to get out of the way. The ball lobs off his body to gully who collects and appeals. Nothing from the umpire.
Taijul Islam walks out to bat.

OUT! Soft dismissals galore, here's another one for the away side! Rabada floats it outside off, Rahman is lured into the drive. Does not bother to keep it down and the ball flies straight into the hands of Parnell at short extra cover. There is a slight fumble but he holds onto the chance. Sabbir departs for a duck. Bangladesh continue to sink further. They still trail South Africa by 508 runs.
Good length outside off, Rahman defends it watchfully.
Back of a length around off, taps it towards the leg side from his crease.
FOUR! Timing! Goes round the wicket and bowls a short one outside off, Das rides the bounce and punches it through point for a boundary.
Similar ball, similar shot, similar result. No runs taken.
Good length ball going across the batsman, no shot offered.
Full and outside off, drives it towards mid off.
Full and outside off, Das wants to drive but mistimes it back down the wicket.
Slants across a length ball outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Back of a length around off, comes in, Rahman stands tall and defends it.
Full outside off, pushed into covers by Sabbir.
Good length outside off, wide enough for Rahman to leave it alone.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in.

OUT! Edged and taken! Rabada bowls it outside off, on a driving length, Kayes drives but without any footwork. The ball takes the outside edge and flies to the left of de Kock behind the wickets. He dives to his strong side and snaps up the catch. Ideal start for South Africa and Bangladesh are five down for nothing! Trail by 512 runs.
Shorter in length outside off, left alone.
Good length around off, Kayes defends it off the inner half back down the wicket.
We are back for the evening session. Imrul Kayes and Liton Das to continue their innings. Kagiso Rabada to bowl first up after tea. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

The visitors still trail the Saffas by as many as 512 runs. That's a mountain of runs and the job is only going to get tougher. Liton Das and Imrul Kayes will hope to stitch a stand and try to resurrect the innings. Let's see what they have to offer in the final session. South Africa will want to keep taking wickets. Join us in a while for the last session of the day.

No respite from South Africa! They are bossing the game completely. They first came out hammering with the bat and now have done the damage with the ball as well. After Faf declared with over 550 on board, both the new ball bowlers struck for the home side. Two more wickets fell for the away side as they were caught in two minds whether to attack or defend.
Short of a length outside off, Das pushes at it but gets it off the outer half to third man. A couple taken. TEA ON DAY 2!
FOUR! Good looking shot! Full length delivery around off, Das drives it down the ground past mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! Just over Elgar! Length delivery outside off, Das strides forward and feels for it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards Dean at third slip who leaps but the ball goes over him in a jiffy and through to the fence.
Fuller length ball on off, shaping away a touch after pitching. Das comes forward and defends it confidently to mid off.
Parnell hits the deck hard and bowls it around off. Das points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Well played! Back of a length deliver on middle, Kayes moves inside the line and tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Time for the last over before Tea.
Floated delivery, Das strides forward to block it. A tight first over from Maharaj.
Straight again, eased towards short extra cover.
Slow through the air on off, Liton lunges forward and smothers the turn.
On middle and leg, defended solidly off the front foot this time.
Drifting in towards the pads, Das lunges forward to defend but gets it off the inner half to square leg.
Tossed up on middle, milked down to long on for an easy single.
Time for spin. Keshav Maharaj to roll his arm over now. A slip and short leg in place.
Slanting across Liton. He doesn't fiddle with it.
Similar to the delivery that got Mahmudullah out. However, Das doesn't fiddle with it.
Back of a length on off, kept out watchfully.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Liton Das comes out to bat. Bangladesh under severe pressure here.

OUT! Bangladesh are in dire straits now! Everything is falling apart for them. Good length delivery outside off, some extra bounce on that. Mahmudullah shapes to force it through covers initially but the zip does him in. He is too late to bail out of the stroke. Ends up getting a faint nick behind and de Kock does the rest. Parnell is a happy man and why not!
FOUR! Not the way Parnell would have liked to bowl his first delivery on a comeback. Fractionally overpitched outside off, Mahmudullah carves it through point for a majestic boundary.
Wayne Parnell comes into the attack. He is coming back into the Test team after a long time and will be eager to make his mark.
Well-directed bouncer on off, angling away. Kayes drops his wrists and allows it to go.

FOUR! Kayes is picking the gap at the moments! However, this is a good ploy from South Africa and they need to stick to it. Bouncer on middle and leg, Kayes pulls it uppishly past the left side of the deep square leg fielder for a boundary.
Moves inside the line to a good length delivery and looks to tuck it in the same region but the ball brushes his thigh pad.
FOUR! Well-controlled! Short delivery on leg stump, Kayes swivels across and pulls it with aplomb through the vacant fine leg region to find the fence.
Similar length delivery in line of the stumps, Kayes hops and keeps it out to mid-wicket.
Short of a length delivery around off, defended off the back foot to point.
Length delivery on middle and leg, tucked off the back foot to mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length on off, Mahmudullah looks to fend it off but the ball hits him on the shoulder. Markram at short leg shows great reflexes and dives towards the ball.
Around the hips, Kayes whips it past Markram at short leg for a run. The replays show that Aiden had his eyes right on the ball but had to take his eyes off in the end eventually.
Fuller in length on off, Kayes strides forward and defends it.
Full length delivery on off, eased to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, tapped to point.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! What a spectacular catch! Probably one of the best catches I have ever seen. Temba Bavuma, you little beauty! Short of a length delivery outside off, width on offer. Rahim hops and forces it uppishly towards gully. Bavuma stationed there dives full length to his right like a goalkeeper and grabs it one-handed. That was really traveling, almost behind him and to pluck that out of thin air requires some serious skills. His teammates run towards him to congratulate him. Ottis Gibson, the head coach and Charl Langeveldt, the bowling coach in SA dressing room can't believe it either! It looks all gloomy for the visitors now with the skipper back in the hut.
Similar length delivery around off, played with an angled bat to point.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim guides it intentionally to gully.
Straying on the pads, clipped to fine leg to rotate strike.
Fullish delivery on off, Rahim drives it down the ground. The timing is not that good. The fielder runs after it and saves a run for his side.
Short delivery outside off, Kayes shapes for the pull but decides not to go through with it.
Good length ball on off, kept out watchfully.
Another well-directed bouncer on middle, Kayes sits underneath it. The Proteas are breathing fire at the moment!
Leg bye! Down the leg side, Rahim looks to clip it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and rolls to backward square leg. De Kock himself runs after it and keeps it down to a run.
Length delivery around off, Rahim strides forward and blocks it.
Rabada runs in from around the wicket and bowls a short of a length ball on off, Kayes taps it to point for a brisk single.
FOUR! Not convincing but the skipper will take it! Back of a length outside off, Rahim plays away from the body and gets it off the outer half behind point for a boundary.
Welcomes Rahim with a brute of a delivery. Well-directed bouncer in line of the stumps, Rahim somehow ducks under it. That really took off.
The skipper, Mushfiqur Rahim comes out to bat. Bangladesh in a spot of bother.

OUT! The short ball has done the trick! Good bowling from Olivier and he reaps the reward. He steams in and bowls a short delivery around the rib cage of Haque. He shuffles a bit, tries to fend it away but only manages to get some glove on it. The ball flies towards Quinton de Kock behind the stumps who moves to his right and takes a regulation catch. South Africa right on top!
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short and width on offer, Haque places it through cover-point. The ball rolls over the sawdust but still races to the fence. Good timing!
Shortish delivery down the leg side, left alone.
Good length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
FOUR! Nicely done! This time he gets the shot right. Shortish delivery on off, Kayes is up on his toes and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller in length in line of the stumps, played with soft hands beside the pitch on the leg side.
Short delivery outside off, Imrul goes for a pull but misses.
Kayes again pushes at a similar length delivery but again gets it off the outer half but this time to gully.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Back of a length delivery, slanting across Kayes. He pushes at it but gets it off the outer half through the gap between third slip and gully for a boundary.
That's a snorter! Well-directed short delivery on off, Kayes rises with the bounce, drops his wrists at the last moment and manages to evade it. Pretty well played in the end.
As expected, Olivier bowls it short down the leg side, Haque points his bat skywards to leave it alone.
Time for a short ball? Leg gully comes in place. Interesting that it was Rabada from deep fine leg that pointed it out to Duanne.
Around the hips, tucked around the corner for a run. Finally a run for Bangladesh after 21 deliveries.
Short delivery around off, Kayes shows good technique as he drops his wrists to let it go.
Back of a length around off, punched from within the crease to covers.
Length delivery in line of the stumps, Kayes tucks it towards Markram at short leg who dives to his right to make a good stop.
Full length delivery on middle, tapped with soft hands to mid on.
Shortish delivery angling away from Haque. He plays inside the line to allow it through. A productive over for SA.
Back of a length delivery on off, Haque stays back and defends it.
Mominul Haque comes out to bat. He played a brilliant knock in the first innings in the previous Test. Bangladesh need him to stand tall.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Poor batting from Sarkar and he pays the price for it. He moves inside the line anticipating the short delivery. Rabada however bowls it around leg stump. Soumya tries to tuck it away but misses it completely to get his stumps rattled. The opener certainly got surprised. Rabada is up and running.
Length delivery on off, Sarkar covers the line and blocks it watchfully.
Fuller length ball around off, encouraging the drive. However, Soumya mistimes it to mid off.
Fullish delivery on off, Sarkar plays it with soft hands back to Rabada.
Good length delivery on middle, Kayes camps back and keeps it out towards the fielder at short leg.
Bouncer but this time this time it is down the leg side, Imrul goes for a full fledged pull shot but misses.
Similar length ball, Imrul places it to the same region.
Short of a length delivery around off, tapped off the back foot towards cover-point. He looks for a run but the fielder is quick to get across to it.
Brilliant bowling from Olivier. He steams in and bangs in a bouncer at 140.9 clicks on off, Kayes drops his wrists and manages to evade it.
On a length on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length around off, eased to covers.
Rabada is causing all sorts of troubles! Another bouncer on off, Sarkar is again in an uncomfortable position and somehow manages to evade it.
Stays back to the length delivery and blocks it.

Another nervy moment! Banged in short on off, Sarkar is in a tangle as he looks to fend it off. Gets some glove on it and the ball lobs towards gully. The fielder sprints in but the ball falls well short of the fielder. He had taken his bottom hand off.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Poor bowling! Back of a length delivery outside off, Sarkar gets on top of the bounce and slaps it through point to find the fence. That was the same region from which the fielder was moved.
A man at deep backward square leg in place now. The batsmen might be peppered with the short stuff.
Good length ball on off, shaping away sharply. Kayes leaves it alone. A testing over from Olivier comes to an end.
Slanting across Imrul. He doesn't fiddle with it.

In the air... but safe! Follows a yorker with a well-directed bouncer on leg stump. Sarkar is caught off guard and just fends it away by taking his bottom hand off. Gets it uppishly to long leg for a run.
Brilliant pinpoint yorker on middle, Sarkar is alert to it and jams it out. This is a great delivery to bowl to a batsman early in his innings.
Length delivery around off, Sarkar plants his front foot across to let it go.

An optimistic appeal really! Full length delivery around leg stump, swinging away. Sarkar tries to clip it away but misses to get rapped on the pads. Olivier is the only one interested but the umpire stays put.
A bit fuller this time around off, swinging away. Kayes knows where his off stump is and makes a measured leave.
Short of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot to covers.
Slips this one down the leg side, Kayes looks to play it across but misses.
On a good length on off, seams away substantially after landing. Kayes watches it carefully and makes a good leave.
Shortish delivery, angling across Imrul. He drops his wrists to allow it through.
Wicket-to-wicket line from Rabada. Kayes covers the line and defends it calmly down the track.
Similar length delivery, Sarkar stays back and blocks it solidly.
Back of a length ball on leg stump, Soumya moves inside the line and looks to tuck it away but takes a blow around his hips.
FOUR! Cracking stroke! Shortish delivery, angling away from the southpaw. Sarkar stands tall and punches it past point for the first boundary of the innings. He is off the mark as well.
In the zone outside off, Soumya doesn't fiddle with it this time.
Loose shot! Very full outside off, pretty wide. Sarkar looks to carve it through square of the wicket on the off side but fails to get bat on ball.
On the money straightaway! Fullish delivery on off, swinging in. Kayes jams it out off the inner half through mid-wicket for three runs.
Duanne Olivier to share the new cherry from the other end.
Around the hips, Sarkar plays it towards the fielder at short leg who shows good reflexes to stop certain runs.
Rabada loses his radar this time. Slips this one down the leg side and Sarkar misses his tuck.
Almost an action replay of the previous delivery as Soumya leaves it again.
This is good bowling, probing around that off stump channel. Rabada hits the deck hard and generates good bounce. Sarkar points his bat skywards to let it go.
Back of a length delivery on middle, seaming away after pitching. Sarkar hangs back and keeps it out tentatively. Oohs and Aahs from the South Africans.
First run for Bangladesh! Rabada starts off with a length delivery on the hips, Kayes hops and tucks it to long leg for a run.
